title: Transfer of nonlocality and entanglement of an open three-qubit W state in the background of dilaton black hole
summary: Constrained by the complexity of theoretical calculations, current research on genuine tripartite nonlocality (GTN) within the relativistic framework concentrates mainly on Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger-like states, with few studies addressing W states or even general tripartite states. In this paper, we apply numerical methods to investigate how environmental decoherence and spacetime dilaton influence GTN and genuine tripartite entanglement (GTE) of W states.
